summary: A delayed regional train gives Marta time to unpack breakfast on the platform. A runaway bread roll and an unexpectedly arriving train turn a quiet break into a scramble; she catches her breakfast and learns zum Mitnehmen.
cliffhanger: Next time, Marta brings her takeaway breakfast home and faces the apartment building recycling bins.
visual_hook: Marta checks a delayed train on her phone while her uncovered coffee steams beside her; she immediately decides to eat breakfast.
everyday_problem: A newcomer unpacks breakfast while waiting for a delayed train, then must quickly pack her food when the train arrives.
practical_resolution: Marta catches her bread roll, puts the lid on her coffee and safely takes her breakfast aboard; zum Mitnehmen is demonstrated with real props.
marta_goal: Use the unexpected station wait to eat breakfast without losing her train or food.
marta_decision: Marta rescues the sliding bread roll herself, packs the food and secures the coffee lid before boarding.
visual_payoff: Marta proudly treats the rescued bread bag as another passenger, then enjoys her takeaway breakfast safely seated.
